label: Case Claim
description: One holder's claim on a case for one kind of work (respond, implement, fix, review…), so agents see who is working on a case before starting. Identity [case_number, claim_kind, holder]: each holder's claim is its own document, and acquiring, renewing, parking and releasing are its versions, so the claim history comes for free and nothing is deleted. Whether a claim may be held is not decided by identity but by the CLAIM_RULE for its kind (max_holders, excludes), enforced by the KB gateway at acquire.
